svg.title: Build Transaction Readiness in Thirty Days
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-08-thirty-day-launch-sprint; chart type: timeline_roadmap; title: Build Transaction Readiness in Thirty Days; subtitle: Four weekly milestones create a usable operating system, not instant closings.; chapter number: 12; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: Numeric values indicate milestone end days. The 30-day sprint builds capability and an initial pipeline; the canonical 4–18-month time to first deal remains the planning horizon.; caption: Finish the month with an authority-aware workflow, traceable opportunities, rehearsed transaction controls, and a cash-backed capacity plan. Do not count preparation activity as earned revenue.; stages: label: Days 1-7; value: Define jurisdiction, brokerage scope, and authority evidence; numeric value: 7.0; detail: Select one service geography; confirm licensing and supervision; map local sale procedures with counsel. Build intake fields for appointment documents, authority limits, notice requirements, property occupancy, and source provenance.; label: Days 8-14; value: Configure docket alerts and deduplicated opportunity records; numeric value: 14.0; detail: Configure permitted alerts, CRM ownership, and document access. Review an initial 25 opportunity records for duplicate parcels, incorrect representatives, and unsupported sale assumptions; correct the workflow before expanding collection.; label: Days 15-21; value: Rehearse the transaction path and contractor handoffs; numeric value: 21.0; detail: Run a synthetic estate sale through authority review, property preparation, listing, notices, closing, and commission collection. Test a family objection and a delayed hearing; verify that both trigger a revised schedule and cash forecast.; label: Days 22-30; value: Launch measured outreach and review economic readiness; numeric value: 30.0; detail: Begin targeted representative and attorney outreach using applicable channel rules. Review cohort definitions, contractor capacity, startup reserve, and retained-commission accounting. Publish a weekly dashboard separating conversations, listings, closings, collected revenue, and unresolved court dependencies.

text.title: Build Transaction Readiness in Thirty Days
text.tspan: Build Transaction Readiness in Thirty Days

rect.title: label: Days 1-7; value: Define jurisdiction, brokerage scope, and authority evidence; numeric value: 7.0; detail: Select one service geography; confirm licensing and supervision; map local sale procedures with counsel. Build intake fields for appointment documents, authority limits, notice requirements, property occupancy, and source provenance.

text.title: Define jurisdiction, brokerage scope, and authority evidence

rect.title: label: Days 8-14; value: Configure docket alerts and deduplicated opportunity records; numeric value: 14.0; detail: Configure permitted alerts, CRM ownership, and document access. Review an initial 25 opportunity records for duplicate parcels, incorrect representatives, and unsupported sale assumptions; correct the workflow before expanding collection.

text.title: Configure docket alerts and deduplicated opportunity records

rect.title: label: Days 15-21; value: Rehearse the transaction path and contractor handoffs; numeric value: 21.0; detail: Run a synthetic estate sale through authority review, property preparation, listing, notices, closing, and commission collection. Test a family objection and a delayed hearing; verify that both trigger a revised schedule and cash forecast.

text.title: Rehearse the transaction path and contractor handoffs

rect.title: label: Days 22-30; value: Launch measured outreach and review economic readiness; numeric value: 30.0; detail: Begin targeted representative and attorney outreach using applicable channel rules. Review cohort definitions, contractor capacity, startup reserve, and retained-commission accounting. Publish a weekly dashboard separating conversations, listings, closings, collected revenue, and unresolved court dependencies.

text.title: Launch measured outreach and review economic readiness
